name: shift-toggle
description: Example circuit of the TAP drafts: an 8-bit shift register and a toggle.

inputs.name: d
inputs.description: Bit shifted into the history by this beat.

inputs.name: en
inputs.description: When true, this beat flips the phase.

outputs.name: oldest_n
outputs.description: Inverse of the oldest history bit before this beat.

state.name: hist
state.description: The last eight values of d. Bit 0 is the newest.

state.name: phase
state.description: Flips on every beat that has en set.
